messages:
Nora: quick sketch idea: add a one-line 'summary strip' under the p95 heatmap. shows route, tiny sparkline, p50/p95 and a small delta badge. click to expand.

Imran: looks useful. concern: live updates may cause reflow on low-end devices. propose throttle=5s.

Jules: accessibility: each row should be role=button with an accessible name. announce on focus: 'Summary row for route /v1/chat — p95 340ms, up 4%'.

Aisha: copy nit: show 'p95' but tooltip 'p95 (95th percentile)' for newcomers. keep pill text short: 'Sampling: Auto'.

Imran: sampling: show sampled/exact pill. clicking pill opens a quick explainer about cost tradeoffs.

Nora: visual: sparklines 40x12px, delta caret on hover reveals exact numbers. right-align a 24px sampling pill.

Jules: screen reader rule: debounce aria-live to 12s and only announce >10% changes to avoid spam.

Imran: backend: return compact per-route payload: route_id, name, p50, p95, delta_pct, spark_buckets, sampling_mode. make it CSV-like and cache for 30s.

Aisha: copy options for explainer: 'Representative — stratified sampling keeps trends stable' and 'Exact — computes full percentiles (higher cost)'.

Nora: action items: Nora update figma frames; Imran spec compact API + sampling flag; Jules run contrast+a11y tests; Aisha finalize microcopy. ui-bot: Created ticket #4272 assigned to team.

Nora: thanks — will upload frames tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
